description: Fetches a conversation's history of messages and events.

channel.description: Conversation ID to fetch history for.

cursor.description: Paginate through collections by setting cursor to next_cursor.

inclusive.description: Include messages with oldest or latest timestamps in results. Default: false.

latest.description: Only messages before this Unix timestamp will be included. Default: now.

oldest.description: Only messages after this Unix timestamp will be included. Default: 0.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (max: 999). Default: 100.
